description: Sign your human up for a free PubSpace space (no card) without leaving this session. Callable without an API key. Only call it after the human has told you their email and chosen a space name; never invent or guess either. Their pages will live at <subdomain>.pubspace.ai, so treat the name as permanent (renames are limited). A 6-digit verification code is emailed to them: ask them to read it to you, then call verify_email. Once verified, publish_page works in this same session. Returns { subdomain, email, apiKey, verificationRequired, connectHint }; persist the key with the connectHint command so future sessions start connected. Fails with email_taken (they already have an account: have them sign in and copy their key from Settings → Connect your agent), subdomain_taken, invalid_subdomain, invalid_email or rate_limited. If this session is already connected with a key, it fails with already_connected.

email.description: The human's real email address, as they gave it to you. The verification code goes here.

subdomain.description: The space name the human chose: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Becomes <subdomain>.pubspace.ai.

name: create_account
